acquisition method: An Orbitrap mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent acquisition mode using Xcalibur 4.3.73.11 software
cleavage agent: trypsin, chymotrypsin, or alpha lytic protease
followed by in-gel digestion with trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI), chymotrypsin (Promega, Madison, WI), or alpha lytic protease (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO)
collision energy: followed by 3 s data-dependent MS/MS scans in an Ion Routing Multipole at stepped 27, 30, 33 normalized collision energy (HCD).
enrichment method: gel bands corresponding to S protein were excised from the gel
two replicates of gel bands corresponding to S protein were excised from the gel
instrument: analyzed by Orbitrap Q Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
